The image shows a coffee leaf with characteristic circular lesions — brown/tan spots with lighter gray-white centers and yellow halos, distributed across the leaf surface. This is the classic "eye spot" appearance of Cercospora coffeicola (Brown Eye Spot disease) on coffee.
